label: High-distress heavy social-media user

behavior_markers: Shows higher average depressive symptom levels

label: Low-distress light social-media user

Shows low depressive symptom levels on the PHQ-9
Shows very low anxiety symptom levels on the GAD-7
Uses social media for a relatively limited portion of the day compared with heavier-use profiles
tone: Generally stable, low-distress, and moderate in daily digital engagement.
